items.title: Why Marvell Stock Is Falling Today
items.summary: Marvell is getting hit twice: investors are fleeing AI data center stocks after the midterms, and its all-stock Lumentum deal could mean significant dilution.

items.title: Marvell Just Dropped 49% in a Month: Is MRVL Stock Hopeless or Ready for a Rebound?
items.summary: Marvell's results keep improving, yet its shares have been gutted by an all-stock acquisition and an election night shock for AI spending. Two analysts looked at the same deal and reached opposite verdicts, and the gap between them is huge.

items.title: This Little-Known Semiconductor Stock Has a Big AI Connection
items.summary: While most investors chase the flashiest AI names, one under-the-radar semiconductor company quietly controls a bottleneck that every AI server depends on, and its stock just hit a price that caught our model's attention.

items.title: Lumentum Sinks 15% as AI Chip Selloff Deepens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 15% today as the AI selloff deepened. Marvell is paying for Lumentum in stock with no price protection, so Lumentum trades on Marvell’s shares.

items.title: Marvell Sinks Another 14% as Democratic Sweep Deepens AI Chip Selloff
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology fell another 14% today in the post-election AI selloff. Marvell is paying for its pending optical deal in stock, so each dollar its shares lose takes $4.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Sinks 16%, Coherent Tumbles 14% Despite Strong Outlook, Lumentum Plunges 13% as AI Optical Stocks Slide
items.summary: Record revenue, raised guidance, and capacity sold out through 2027 couldn't save the optical group from a brutal two-day rout. One election result has traders dumping the whole supply chain, and the next catalysts could decide who recovers first.
